nodes.body: Dusk fell soft and purple over the sleepy meadow. High above, Twinkle the littlest star woke up in her fluffy cloud bed and rubbed her eyes. Tonight was her very first night to shine all by herself. Her tummy did one small flutter-flop.

choices.label: Peek out at the wide night sky above the sleepy meadow.

nodes.body: Kind, round Moon rose slowly and smiled right at her. "The sky is waiting for your little light," Moon whispered. Twinkle felt fluttery and shy inside. She squeezed her two points tight, tight, tight. Then she took one big breath and got ready to be brave.

choices.label: Take a big, brave breath.

nodes.body: Twinkle floated to her very own spot in the sky. She looked around. How should a star start to shine? She could hide behind the fluffy cloud. She could do a big sparkle wiggle. Or she could scoot down low to peek at the world below.

choices.label: Hide behind the fluffy cloud.
Do a big sparkle wiggle.
Scoot down to peek at the world below.

nodes.body: Twinkle tucked herself behind the fluffy cloud. Only the tiniest tip of her glow peeked out. The cloud was soft and cozy. But her own little spot stayed dark and empty. Should she snuggle in deeper? Or peek out just one tiny sparkle?

choices.label: Snuggle deeper into the fluffy cloud.
Peek out one tiny sparkle.

nodes.body: Deep in the cloud, Twinkle rested a little while. Kind Moon hummed one soft, low note. The cloud's fluff tickled her nose, and she giggled a tiny giggle. The rest made her feel a bit braver. She floated back to try again.

choices.label: Float back and try again.

nodes.body: Twinkle let one tiny sparkle slip out. It drifted all the way down to the meadow, where a little firefly blinked hello right back. "My light reached somebody!" Twinkle gasped, full of joy. Her glow steadied. It grew warmer, and a little bit bolder.

choices.label: Let the glow grow bigger.

nodes.body: Twinkle wiggled and jiggled to wake up her sparkle. Gold glitter shook off her points and flew everywhere! It was very fun, but very wobbly, and her light flickered like a little hiccup. Should she wiggle even faster? Or slow down and sway like a lullaby?

choices.label: Wiggle even faster!
Slow down and sway like a lullaby.

nodes.body: Twinkle wiggled so fast she spun in a dizzy circle and plopped onto a soft puff of cloud, giggling. Her sparkle went all fizzy, like tiny bubbles. "Gently does it, little one," chuckled kind Moon. Twinkle dusted off her points and floated back to try again.

choices.label: Float back and try again.

nodes.body: Twinkle swayed slowly, side to side, like the tall grass far below. Her sparkle settled into one warm, steady glow. The swaying felt just like a lullaby, so she hummed along softly. Now she felt calm, and ready at last.

choices.label: Glide to her very own spot in the sky.

nodes.body: Twinkle scooted down to peek at the world below. But whoops, the sky was slippery tonight! She slid down, down, down, right past the treetops. She could grab a silvery moonbeam and climb back up. Or she could peek around from down low.

choices.label: Climb the silvery moonbeam back up.
Take a peek from down low.

nodes.body: From down low, Twinkle saw little houses with warm, yellow windows. Children in cozy pajamas peeked up, waiting for the littlest star. Her heart glowed warm as toast. They needed her light tonight. So up, up, up she floated, back toward her very own spot.

choices.label: Float up to her very own spot in the sky.

nodes.body: Back at her very own spot, the sky finally felt just right: soft and dark and quiet as a blanket. Kind Moon nodded proudly. The whole night seemed to wait. Should Twinkle try one tiny practice sparkle first? Or hold a silvery moonbeam and shine all at once?

choices.label: Try one tiny practice sparkle.
Hold a silvery moonbeam and shine all at once.

nodes.body: Twinkle let out one small, practice sparkle. It glowed steady and bright, not wobbly at all! She laughed out loud with happy surprise. Her shyness floated away like a little cloud. Now she was truly ready to shine her whole light.

choices.label: Shine with all her light.

nodes.body: Twinkle took the biggest breath of all. She shone! Soft, silver light spilled bright across the whole sky. Kind Moon beamed with pride. Now Twinkle could wink goodnight to the children below. She could sing a twinkle song with Moon. Or she could invite the other little stars to shine along too.

choices.label: Wink goodnight to children in pajamas.
Sing a twinkle song with kind, round Moon.
Invite the other little stars.

nodes.body: Twinkle twinkled one slow, gentle goodnight wink. Far below, children waved from their windows and snuggled into their beds. The whole sky grew quiet and dreamy under her soft, silver light. Twinkle shone calm and proud, the littlest star, right where she belonged. Goodnight, little world.

Twinkle and kind Moon hummed a twinkle song together. The whole sky rocked slow and gentle, like a cradle. Her light glowed in time with the tune. Down below, sleepy eyes closed, one by one. Twinkle sang the whole world to sleep. She was not one bit shy anymore.

Twinkle called out softly. One by one, the other little stars popped out beside her, blinking hello. Soon the whole sky was full of friendly lights. Shining was easy with friends all around! Twinkle glowed happiest of all, the littlest star who lit up the whole night.
